ABOUT CR POWER
關於華潤電力
China Resources Power Holdings Company Limited (the                    華潤電力控股有限公司（「本公司」或「華
“Company” or “CR Power”) mainly invests, develops, operates            潤 電 力」）主 要 在 中 國 投 資、開 發、運 營
and manages wind farms, photovoltaic power plants, hydro-              和 管 理 風 電 場、光 伏 電 站、水 電 站 及 其
electric power plants and other clean and renewable energy             他清潔及可再生能源項目和燃煤發電廠。
projects and coal-fired power plants in China. Its business also       業 務 還 涉 及 分 佈 式 能 源、售 電、智 慧 能
covers distributed energy, power sales, smart energy, coal mining,     源及煤炭等領域。
and other areas.

As at 31 December 2024, CR Power had 50 coal-fired power               於 2024 年 12 月 31 日，華 潤 電 力 旗 下 併
plants, 205 wind farms, 174 photovoltaic power plants, 20 hydro-       網 50 座燃煤發電廠、205 座風電場、174
electric power plants and 6 gas-fired power plants in commercial       座 光 伏 電 站、20 座 水 電 站 和 6 座 燃 氣 發
operations. Its total attributable grid-connected installed capacity   電 廠。本 公 司 的 合 計 權 益 併 網 裝 機 容 量
was 72,433MW, with 27.3% of its capacity located in Central            為 72,433 兆 瓦，其 中 27.3% 位 於 華 中 地
China, 23.7% in Eastern China, 14.0% in Southern China,                區，23.7% 位 於 華 東 地 區，14.0% 位 於
13.2% in Northern China, 10.6% in Northwestern China, 5.8%             華南地區，13.2% 位於華北地區，10.6%
in Northeastern China, and 5.4% in Southwestern China. Its             位於西北地區，5.8% 位於東北地區以及
attributable grid-connected installed capacity in wind, hydro-         5.4% 位於西南地區。風電、水電及光伏
electric and photovoltaic power in aggregate, amounted to              發電權益併網裝機容量合共 34,188 兆瓦，
34,188MW, accounting for approximately 47.2% of its total              佔總權益併網裝機容量約 47.2%。
attributable grid-connected installed capacity.

CR Power has been selected, for 5 consecutive years, as a              自 2020 年 9 月 7 日 起，華 潤 電 力 已 連 續
constituent of the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index and the Hang Seng            5 年 入 選 恒 生 ESG 50 指 數 成 分 股 和 恒 生
Corporate Sustainability Benchmark Index (“HSSUSB”) since 7            可持續發展企業基準指數。
September 2020.

CR Power has always adhered to the concept of sustainable              華 潤 電 力 始 終 秉 持 可 持 續 發 展 理 念，將
development and integrated the implementation of environmental,        落 實 環 境、社 會 和 企 業 管 治（「 ESG 」）責
social and governance (“ESG”) responsibilities into the Company’s      任 融 入 公 司 戰 略 和 業 務 運 作，公 司 連 續
strategies and operations. The Company has been publishing             15 年發佈可持續發展報告，不斷審視自
sustainability reports for 15 consecutive years, constantly reviews    身 的 表 現 和 不 足，努 力 提 高 踐 行 可 持 續
its own performance and shortcomings, and strives to improve its       發 展 的 能 力，為 企 業 長 遠 的 價 值 創 造 奠
sustainable development practices, laying a solid foundation for       定 基 礎。連 續 5 年 入 選 恒 生 ESG 50 指 數
creating long-term value for the Company. CR Power’s inclusion         以 及 恒 生 可 持 續 發 展 企 業 基 準 指 數，彰
into the Hang Seng ESG 50 Index and HSSUSB for 5 consecutive           顯了華潤電力在 ESG 三個範疇表現卓越，
years demonstrates its excellence in the three aspects of ESG, and     反映了資本市場對公司可持續發展工作
reflects the recognition on the sustainable development efforts of     的認可。
the Company by the capital markets.

CR Power has also been selected as a constituent in the Hang           自 2023 年 6 月 5 日 起，華 潤 電 力 亦 被 納

3. BASIS OF PREPARATION OF                                               3. 編製合併財務報表的基準
   CONSOLIDATED FINANCIAL                                                   及重大會計政策信息
   STATEMENTS AND MATERIAL
   ACCOUNTING POLICY INFORMATION
      3.1 Basis of preparation of consolidated financial                  3.1 編製合併財務報表的基準
          statements
            The consolidated financial statements have been                 合併財務報表已根據由香港會
            prepared in accordance with HKFRSs issued by the                計師公會頒佈之香港財務報
            HKICPA. For the purpose of preparation of the                   告準則編製。就編製合併財務
            consolidated financial statements, information is               報表而言，倘有關資料合理預
            considered material if such information is reasonably           期會影響主要使用者作出的決
            expected to influence decisions made by primary users.          定，則有關資料被視為重大。
            In addition, the consolidated financial statements              此外，合併財務報表載有香港
            include applicable disclosures required by the Rules            聯合交易所有限公司證券上市
            Governing the Listing of Securities on The Stock                規 則（「上 市 規 則」）及 香 港《公

            Revenue from contracts with customers                            來自客戶合約之收益
            The Group recognises revenue when (or as) a                       本 集 團 於 完 成 履 約 責 任 時（即
            performance obligation is satisfied, i.e. when “control”          於特定履約責任下相關商品或
            of the goods or services underlying the particular                服務的「控制權」轉讓予客戶時）
            performance obligation is transferred to the customer.           （或就此）確認收益。

            A performance obligation represents a good or service             履約責任指明確的商品或服務
            (or a bundle of goods or services) that is distinct or a         （或一批商品或服務）或一系列
            series of distinct goods or services that are substantially       大致相同的明確商品或服務。
            the same.

            Control is transferred over time and revenue is                  倘符合以下條件之一，控制權
            recognised over time by reference to the progress                按時間轉移，而收益經參考完
            towards complete satisfaction of the relevant                    全達成相關履約責任的進度隨
            performance obligation if one of the following criteria          時間確認：
            is met:

            •     the customer simultaneously receives and                   •   客戶於本集團履約時同時
                  consumes the benefits provided by the Group’s                  收取及消耗本集團履約所
                  performance as the Group performs;                             提供的利益；

            •     the Group’s performance creates or enhances an             •   本集團的履約創建或增強
                  asset that the customer controls as the Group                  客戶於本集團履約時控制
                  performs; or                                                   的資產；或

            •     the Group’s performance does not create an asset           •   本集團的履約未創建對本
                  with an alternative use to the Group and the                   集團具有替代用途的資
                  Group has an enforceable right to payment for                  產，而本集團有強制執行
                  performance completed to date.                                 權收取至今已履約部分的
                                                                                 款項。

            Otherwise, revenue is recognised at a point in time              否則，於客戶獲得明確商品或
            when the customer obtains control of the distinct good           服務控制權之時點確認收益。
            or service.

46. CAPITAL RISK MANAGEMENT                                         46. 資本風險管理
  The Group’s objectives in managing capital are to safeguard         本集團資本管理旨在保障本集團的
  the Group’s ability to continue as a going concern in order         持續經營能力，以向股東提供回報
  to provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other          及向其他利益相關者提供裨益，維
  stakeholders and to maintain an optimal capital structure in        持優化的資本結構，以降低資本成
  order to reduce the cost of capital.                                本。

  In order to maintain or adjust the capital structure, the Group     為維持或調整資本結構，本集團或
  may adjust the amount of dividends paid to shareholders,            會調整派付予股東的股息金額、返
  return capital to shareholders, issue new shares or sell assets     還資本予股東、發行新股或出售資
  to reduce debt.                                                     產以減少債務。

  The Group monitors its capital based on gearing ratio. This         本集團根據資本負債比率監察其資
  ratio is calculated as net debt divided by total equity. Net        本。該比率按債務淨額除以總權益
  debt is calculated as total borrowings and loans from related       計算。債務淨額按借貸總額及來自
  parties less cash and cash equivalent and pledged and               關連方的貸款減現金及現金等價物
  restricted bank deposits.                                           與已抵押及受限制銀行存款計算。
